changelog.note: Added checked_at to every parameter; product values now age from checked_at instead of as_of. Clarified the watch_full_kit_uplift source note. No values changed.
hei_max_investment_pct_of_value is now a design value (owner decision 2026-10-01): our own eligibility cap, calibrated from Hometap. It no longer goes stale. Value unchanged.

kinds.market: Changes often. Refreshed automatically by script; never edited by the LLM.
kinds.product: Partner terms. A weekly checker may PROPOSE a change; a human must approve before it is used.
kinds.design: Our own choices. Changed only by the owner, with a version bump and a reason.
kinds.reference: Context for explanations only. Never used in a calculation.

rules.dates: as_of = the date the value refers to: the observation or release date for market values; the source's own publication date for product and reference values, or the day we read it when the source shows no date; for design values, the date of the source they were calibrated from, or the owner's decision date when there is none. checked_at = the day we last confirmed the value at its source (null = not confirmed yet; design values do not need it).
rules.staleness: A value used by a calculation is stale when its age is greater than valid_days. Age counts from as_of for market values (the data itself gets old) and from checked_at for product values (a term stays current until the partner changes it; a null checked_at counts as stale). Design values never go stale and reference values never block. If any value used by a calculation is stale, the agent must not finalize a recommendation and must show 'needs fresh data'.
rules.receipt: Every recommendation records registry_version so the result can be reproduced later.

mortgage_30y_fixed_avg.source: Freddie Mac PMMS (published Thursdays 12pm ET; history downloadable as .xlsx)

heloc_avg_rate.source: Curinos via Yahoo Finance; applies to credit score >= 780 and CLTV < 70%. No public API verified: entered manually weekly.

home_equity_loan_avg_rate.source: Curinos via Yahoo Finance; same conditions as heloc_avg_rate

sofr.source: FRED series SOFR (API: fred/series/observations, JSON, API key)

hei_investor_discount.source: Calibrated from Hometap X-for-Y example: 10% cash for a 15% share of future value (years 0-3) => 1 - 10/15

hei_fee_rate.source: Point HEI processing fee: up to 3.9%, minimum $2,000 (plus third-party closing costs)

hei_max_investment_pct_of_value.source: Owner decision 2026-10-01: our own eligibility cap, calibrated from Hometap's published maximum of 24.99% of home value (2024 article). Hometap's site blocked access from Korea on 2026-10-01; 2026 third-party reviews cite 25% (LendEDU, 2026-09-10) and 27% of equity (Finder, 2026-06-25).

hei_investor_return_cap.source: Owner decision 2026-10-01 (Point also uses time-based caps)

hei_term_years.source: Owner decision 2026-10-01 (Hometap up to 10 years; Point up to 30 years)

heloc_first_threshold_years.source: Owner decision 2026-10-01: if repayment is planned within this horizon, show HELOC/home equity loan first

reverse_mortgage_min_age.source: CFPB: HECM reverse mortgage is only for homeowners 62 and older

watch_dealer_offer_range.source: Dealer guide (2026): dealers pay roughly 10-30% less than market value; same day locally, next day if shipped

chrono24_private_seller_fee.source: Chrono24 FAQ: 6.5% commission after sale; listing free; escrow checkout

watch_loan_ltv.source: Borro guide (lender self-reported, 2026-03-19): LTV 60-80%; terms 30-180 days; lender holds the watch; rates not disclosed

watch_full_kit_uplift.source: Borro guide: full kit (box, outer box, papers, hangtags) adds 10-15% for most steel sport references; papers alone roughly half that

avm_median_error.source: Zillow figures as quoted by a third-party article (date not stated)
